Use case: game UI visual mockup. Create a polished design concept for the Roblox game Rob A Piggy Bank. Input image is ONLY a reference for the current plum rebirth color and simple low-poly Roblox world; redesign the UI substantially. Art direction: bright colorful low-poly cartoon game, warm cream panels, thick smooth dark cocoa outlines, plum prestige accents, sunny gold, teal and coral supporting colors, friendly chunky rounded display lettering and very legible clean body text. Simple low-poly item illustrations, restrained soft bevels, very little fine detail. No ornate fantasy trim, no glitter, no neon glow, no photoreal objects, no dramatic particles, no search bar. All text sharp and readable. Gold rebirth emblem is two broad curved arrows surrounding a small piggy-shaped coin. No sparkle emoji. Keep generous spacing and strong hierarchy. All diagrams and values are design samples.
Asset type: DESKTOP decision modal concept, landscape 2048x1536. Show one centered complete modal over a subtly dimmed colorful low-poly neighborhood background. UI takes about 84% width, 87% height; leave room around floating elements. Front-on screen design, no device frame. Rounded cream shell, detached smooth plum tab overlapping upper left reads "REBIRTH 12", gold rebirth emblem protruding left, rounded red close button with cream X sticking out above upper right. Subtitle "A stronger fresh start". Four beautifully arranged reward cards in a 2x2 grid with small colorful icon wells at left and clear text at right. Card 1 golden coin: "Permanent coin bonus", large "+128% → +136%", small "Applies at every income level". Card 2 simple pink piggy with rising blocks: "Higher upgrade limit", large "Lv 42 → Lv 44", small "Earn Faster + Bigger Piggy Bank". Card 3 gold-accented toy wooden crate: "Free crate opening", "Rare 65% · Legendary 35%", underlined "View possible rewards". Card 4 simple low-poly green Acorn tree: "Online Acorn growth", large "+33% → +36%", small "While you're playing". Below cards use compact, clearly separated side-by-side sections: coral-tinted "RESETS" with three lines "Piggy coins → 0", "Income & capacity levels → 1", "Bought upgrades → 0"; pale mint-tinted "YOU KEEP" with three lines "Skins, home & rides", "Items & Acorns", "Achievements & progress". A slim readiness row beneath with "Piggy requirement met" and teal "READY" badge. Fixed cream bottom footer separated by cocoa hairline contains small readable sentence "Coins and bought upgrades reset. Your collection stays." Then two large buttons: cream "NOT YET" left, plum "REBIRTH TO 12" right with gold arrow emblem. No invented prices, no guaranteed legendary skin. At outer bottom edge label small "DESKTOP CONCEPT · SAMPLE VALUES". Balanced compact UI, colorful illustrated rewards more prominent than explanatory text.

Asset type: MOBILE LANDSCAPE decision modal concept, landscape 1792x1024. This is a compact mobile adaptation, do not merely shrink a desktop interface. No photographic phone bezel. A clean landscape Roblox game screenshot with dimmed low-poly neighborhood around a compact cream modal occupying center 85% width and 82% height. Generous safe margins around the modal and its sticking-out red X. Smooth floating plum header tab "REBIRTH 12" with gold rebirth emblem at upper left; X upper right. Four compact reward cards in a 2x2 arrangement, large simple icons left with SHORT labels at right: 1 "Coin bonus" large "+128% → +136%"; 2 "Upgrade limit" large "Lv 42 → Lv 44"; 3 "Free crate opening" small "Rare 65% · Legendary 35%" with "View rewards"; 4 "Acorn growth" large "+33% → +36%" small "Online only". Beneath benefits two compact summary blocks side by side: coral "RESETS" followed by "Piggy coins + bought upgrades"; mint "YOU KEEP" followed by "Collection, home, rides + Acorns". Small secondary line below keep: "Achievements stay too". A thin vertical scrollbar at right of body suggests expandable details scroll INSIDE the modal. Fixed bottom footer visibly outside the scrolling body. Footer first line "Coins reset to 0. Core upgrades reset to Lv 1." second compact line "Requirement met" with a tiny teal check. Two chunky broad thumb-friendly buttons side by side "NOT YET" cream and "REBIRTH TO 12" plum. Text clearly readable; visual hierarchy fitted to landscape phone proportions, no tiny desktop paragraphs, no gameplay buttons floating on top of modal. Label below screenshot "MOBILE LANDSCAPE · COMPACT LAYOUT · SAMPLE VALUES".

Asset type: close-up presentation of ONE redesigned REBIRTH HUD BUTTON, landscape 1536x1024. Clean warm ivory presentation background. In the center show a large enlarged view of the new horizontal button, width about 75% canvas, height about 24% canvas. Smooth slightly asymmetric rounded plum plaque, subtle swept right edge, thick consistent cocoa outline, fine warm lighter-plum inner edge, modest bevel. At left, a beautiful gold chunky rebirth emblem, two broad rounded arrows circling a simple piggy coin; icon overlaps outside left edge and is slightly taller than button, no additional circular background. It must look easy to read and low-poly cartoon themed, not jeweled or complicated. Below the large view, show a small cropped strip of low-poly Roblox gameplay with the SAME button placed at realistic compact HUD scale, one instance only in that strip. Top title "REBIRTH · HUD BUTTON"; small subtitle "A clearer next step". Under gameplay strip say "Tap to preview rewards before confirming". Small bottom caption "BUTTON CONCEPT · ENLARGED DETAIL". No extra variant options, no sparkle emoji, no radiant background, no glowing border.
